mapper.sql: id, product_id, version_code, currency, amount_minor, included_credit_micros, validity_days, entitlement_snapshot, pricing_rule_snapshot, status, sell_from, sell_until, created_at, published_at
mapper.select: SELECT p.product_code, p.product_type, p.display_name, p.description, v.version_code, v.currency, v.amount_minor, v.included_credit_micros, v.validity_days, v.entitlement_snapshot, v.sell_until FROM billing_product p JOIN billing_price_version v ON v.product_id = p.id WHERE p.status = 'ACTIVE' AND v.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND (v.sell_from IS NULL OR v.sell_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) AND (v.sell_until IS NULL OR v.sell_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) ORDER BY CASE p.product_type WHEN 'PLAN' THEN 1 WHEN 'CREDIT_PACK' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, v.amount_minor
SELECT FROM billing_price_version WHERE version_code = #{versionCode} LIMIT 1
